Reference / async/event

async/event#

One-way cooperative readiness signalling.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let started is Event = Event();
let workers = start_workers(signal: started);

prepare_shared_state();
started.set();
await workers.results();

Description#

One-way cooperative readiness signalling.

Synopsis.

Event is a level-triggered one-way latch. wait() suspends while the event is not ready. The first set() makes it ready permanently, releases every current waiter, and lets every future waiter pass immediately. Repeated set() calls are harmless.

Construct Event(ready: true) when the initial state is already ready:

let available is Event = Event(ready: true);
await available.wait();

Cancelling one pending wait() removes only that waiter. It neither signals the event nor affects other waiters.

An event does not count calls to set() and deliberately has no reset(). Create a fresh event for a fresh readiness cycle. Use Channel when each individual signal is a message which must be consumed exactly once.
